description: CloudGrid dependency automation: bun packages, Dockerfile base image, and the mise.toml toolchain. Detection is automatic; nothing merges without review. Dashboard-approval mode: Renovate opens no PR until it is ticked on the dependency dashboard, so the first-run experience is one dashboard issue, not a PR flood.

packageRules.description: Group Bun ecosystem updates (mise pin + oven/bun image + @types/bun) into one PR
